content.title: Artificial Intelligence for Tennis Performance Analysis and Match Prediction
content.abstract: Tennis players' technical movements, movements, spatial behavior, and other aspects during matches can already be well analyzed by artificial intelligence, but the data and game predictions obtained from these analyses still need to be integrate. This is the research direction of this narrative review. This review summarizes the relevant data sources, calculation methods, technical features, performance indicators, and prediction methods.
